text:
Who dies, illustrious Gaspar: you

in grief, or your ill-fated brother?

He did not die, since in a phantom form

your pale memory offers him to us;


You did not die, for in your dawn

the light of a sun that set too soon still shines.

How much what endures in man deceives,

since what is born must perish of its birth!


Happy is he who lives by fame,

not years, and takes this counsel: we breathe

in order to become immortal.


O envy (though it is called pity),

to mourn the one we miss because he ceases

to be what we mourn him for!

translation.title: Who is it, illustrious Gaspar, who dies...
